title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: Payment API experienced complete outage due to database connection pool exhaustion
root_cause: Database connection pool reached maximum capacity (100 connections) during peak traffic. Connections were not being released properly due to missing timeout configuration.
resolution: Restarted payment-api service to clear connections. Increased connection pool size to 200. Added connection timeout of 30 seconds. Implemented connection pool monitoring.

title: Memory Leak in User Service
description: User service memory usage grew from 2GB to 8GB over 6 hours, causing OOM crashes
root_cause: Memory leak in session management code. User sessions were cached indefinitely without expiration.
resolution: Deployed hotfix with session TTL of 24 hours. Implemented memory monitoring alerts.

title: API Latency Spike from Slow Database Query
description: API latency increased from 200ms to 5s affecting all endpoints
root_cause: Missing database index on user_events table. Query scanning 10M rows for each request.
resolution: Added composite index on (user_id, created_at). Query time reduced from 4.8s to 12ms.
